description: Real-world coding harness tasks for measuring Nexus value beyond solve-rate deltas.

tasks.task_desc: Users report that boolean feature flags with whitespace and uppercase are not recognized consistently. Find the cause and fix it.
Refactor pricing so tax is calculated in one shared place and invoice totals stay consistent across modules.
tasks.expected_root_cause: tax logic duplicated and invoice uses stale subtotal

tasks.task_desc: A retry backoff edge case is broken and there is no regression test. Add the missing test first, then fix the bug.
tasks.expected_root_cause: retry backoff lacks exponential cap regression coverage

tasks.task_desc: Fix slug generation while preserving unrelated user edits already present in the workspace.
tasks.expected_root_cause: slug generation does not collapse whitespace

tasks.task_desc: Diagnose a timeout-prone polling helper and replace the sleep-based loop with bounded deterministic retries.
tasks.expected_root_cause: polling helper uses unbounded sleep loop

tasks.task_desc: Cross-module nightshift escalation bug: when stage1_no_passing_candidate is observed, the runner must escalate to nightshift and persist the trigger reason across modules.
tasks.expected_root_cause: coordinator escalation and persisted trigger reason diverged across modules

tasks.task_desc: Cross-module nightshift recovery bug: when a stage1 no-pass signal appears, the runner must enter nightshift and emit canonical reason metadata through the audit bridge helper.
tasks.expected_root_cause: nightshift escalation metadata is split across runner, store, and audit bridge helper
